name: Gilded Mimic
description: A chest of gold plate sits open in the rubble, and something inside it is breathing.

choices.label: Take the loose coins
choices.description: Pocket what spilled out and leave the chest alone.
choices.outcome: You take 150 souls and walk on.

choices.label: Rummage inside
choices.description: Dig through the chest for relics; whatever breathes can wait.
choices.outcome: Two relics fall out, but teeth find your arm.

choices.label: Open it fully
choices.description: Rip the chest wide and meet whatever sleeps inside.
choices.outcome: The mimic lunges and you pay for the prize in blood.

name: Bleeding Road
description: The tunnel ahead is soaked in blood that is still moving.

choices.label: Bind your wounds
choices.description: Stop, wrap the wounds, and let the bleeding stop.
choices.outcome: You close your wounds and feel steadier.

choices.label: Run through it
choices.description: Sprint the bloody stretch before it notices you.
choices.outcome: You break through the blood, wounded and fast.

choices.label: Follow the blood
choices.description: Follow the flow to whatever is feeding on it.
choices.outcome: Something is feeding down there, and it has friends.

name: Shrine of Ash
description: A shrine of grey ash stands open, still warm, with an offering bowl beside it.

choices.label: Pray quietly
choices.description: Leave a little of what you carry and move on.
choices.outcome: The ash accepts your offering and your purse feels lighter.

choices.label: Demand a blessing
choices.description: Ask the shrine for more than it offers to give.
choices.outcome: The shrine grants you a feverish strength.

choices.label: Break the offering
choices.description: Take the bowl, shatter the shrine, and take what it hides.
choices.outcome: Something answers the breaking with teeth.

name: Drowned Saint
description: A saint of the old war lies drowned in the flooded hall, hands still raised.

choices.label: Pay respects
choices.description: Say the old words and let the saint rest.
choices.outcome: The hall quiets and your wounds close.

choices.label: Take the drowned relic
choices.description: The saint wears something that glints in the dark.
choices.outcome: You pull a relic free and the water pulls back.

choices.label: Swim deeper
choices.description: Dive after the saint to see what it guards below.
choices.outcome: The deep water holds a guardian.

name: Twin Mirrors
description: Two black mirrors lean against each other, each showing a different version of you.

choices.label: Look into one mirror
choices.description: Study a single reflection and take nothing else.
choices.outcome: You learn a little of the pit and pay a little of your blood.

choices.label: Look into both
choices.description: Meet both versions of yourself at once.
choices.outcome: Both reflections teach you the same lesson, in blood.

choices.label: Shatter both
choices.description: Break the mirrors and take whatever falls out.
choices.outcome: Glass, teeth and a fight for what is hidden.

name: Wandering Alchemist
description: A hooded alchemist sets a small furnace down in the middle of the corridor.

choices.label: Buy a cheap tonic
choices.description: Pay for the mildest brew and keep walking.
choices.outcome: A weak brew, but it closes your wounds.

choices.label: Drink the strange tonic
choices.description: Drink whatever the alchemist is smiling about.
choices.outcome: Something in you starts mending itself.

choices.label: Steal the recipes
choices.description: Take the alchemist papers and run before the summoning finishes.
choices.outcome: The furnace erupts as you run.

name: Bone Market
description: Reavers trade relic parts in a hollow lined with stacked bones.

choices.label: Buy a bone charm
choices.description: Pay for a knotted charm and stay out of the trade.
choices.outcome: The charm is ugly and it holds.

choices.label: Haggle for the good stock
choices.description: Push your luck on the best relics in the hollow.
choices.outcome: You get the good stock and a knife for it.

choices.label: Rob the market
choices.description: Take everything on the tables and run for the tunnel.
choices.outcome: The reavers do not take kindly to theft.

name: Pit Whisper
description: A voice from under the stones knows your name and your next move.

choices.label: Listen quietly
choices.description: Listen, say nothing, and gather your strength.
choices.outcome: The whisper fades and you feel steadier.

choices.label: Answer the whisper
choices.description: Give the voice an answer and take its gift.
choices.outcome: Your casts come faster, the voice charges for them.

choices.label: Shout back
choices.description: Answer loudly enough that the whole wall hears you.
choices.outcome: The pit answers louder, and pays you for the volume.

name: Cursed Bargain
description: A hand of bone and gold offers a contract written in your own blood.

choices.label: Take the purse and go
choices.description: Take the dropped purse and leave the contract on the table.
choices.outcome: You walk away richer and still whole.

choices.label: Take the deal
choices.description: Sign for the power, whatever it takes from your body.
choices.outcome: You are stronger for a while, and weaker for good.

choices.label: Sign in blood
choices.description: Sign your name in blood and make the contract binding.
choices.outcome: The contract seals and the pit comes to collect.

name: Drowned Merchant
description: A merchant waits in the flooded hall, crates chained to his drowned cart.

choices.label: Trade fairly
choices.description: Pay the asking price and take what you came for.
choices.outcome: A fair trade in a place with no fair prices.

choices.label: Haggle hard
choices.description: Push the price down and take more for your trouble.
choices.outcome: You talk him down and he charges you in blood.

choices.label: Smuggle his crates
choices.description: Take the crates and find your own way out of the hall.
choices.outcome: The crates are heavy and the hall is not empty.

name: Thousand Eyes
description: The wall of the chamber is made of eyes, and every one of them blinks at you.

choices.label: Look away
choices.description: Keep your head down and walk past the wall.
choices.outcome: The eyes let you pass, this time.

choices.label: Stare back
choices.description: Meet the wall eye for eye and see what it sees.
choices.outcome: The wall shows you your own hide, and hardens you.

choices.label: Blind them
choices.description: Put the wall out for good and take what it was guarding.
choices.outcome: The wall fights back, and the room pays for it.

name: Last Gift
description: A wrapped gift from no one sits in the middle of the road, still warm.

choices.label: Accept the gift
choices.description: Take the gift as it is and keep walking.
choices.outcome: A kind gift from a kind pit, which is rare.

choices.label: Open it early
choices.description: Rip it open where you stand and take the prize now.
choices.outcome: The gift opens early and so does something else.

choices.label: Take everything
choices.description: Take the gift, the shrine around it and whatever waits inside.
choices.outcome: The hollow throne sends its own collector.
